# Toolyfi

> Free online tools for everyone — fast, no signup required.

Toolyfi provides a collection of free browser-based utility tools including calculators, converters, generators, and more.

## Tools

- [Age Calculator](https://toolyfi.com/age-calculator.html): Calculate exact age from date of birth
- [BMI Calculator](https://toolyfi.com/bmi-calculator.html): Calculate Body Mass Index
- [Case Converter](https://toolyfi.com/case-converter.html): Convert text between uppercase, lowercase, title case
- [Color Picker](https://toolyfi.com/color-picker.html): Pick and convert colors (HEX, RGB, HSL)
- [Image Compressor](https://toolyfi.com/image-compressor.html): Compress images online for free
- [Image Resizer](https://toolyfi.com/image-resizer.html): Resize images to custom dimensions
- [Loan Calculator](https://toolyfi.com/loan-calculator.html): Calculate loan EMI and interest
- [Number to Words](https://toolyfi.com/number-to-words.html): Convert numbers to words
- [Password Generator](https://toolyfi.com/password-generator.html): Generate strong secure passwords
- [Percentage Calculator](https://toolyfi.com/percentage-calculator.html): Calculate percentages easily
- [QR Code Generator](https://toolyfi.com/qr-code-generator.html): Generate QR codes instantly
- [Random Number Generator](https://toolyfi.com/random-number-generator.html): Generate random numbers
- [Scientific Calculator](https://toolyfi.com/scientific-calculator.html): Advanced scientific calculations
- [Unit Converter](https://toolyfi.com/unit-converter.html): Convert between units of measurement
- [Word Counter](https://toolyfi.com/word-counter.html): Count words, characters, and sentences

## About

Toolyfi is a free, ad-supported web tool platform. No registration required. All tools run in the browser.
